name: storm-canonical-workflow
summary: Machine-readable BMAD-METHOD v7 Storm workflow contract: storm-build is the explicit Storm lifecycle wrapper around unwrapped upstream bmad-build; legacy story names warn and forward directly to upstream Build without Storm lifecycle hooks; bmad-sprint-planning owns readiness, status, validation, repair, and every sprint-status projection write; and Polytoken implementation follows plan -> reviewed handoff_plan -> active saved goal -> execute -> read_goal -> storm-linear open -> mutation.

enforcement.statement: This contract is enforced at the directive/prompt and permission-classifier level plus the deterministic validators listed below. Polytoken does not provide a physical sandbox that makes plan-facet mutation impossible; the shipped plan facet exposes shell_exec, so its read-only posture is prompt- and permission-enforced. Deterministic validators prove contract conformance of transcripts and assets; only disposable Polytoken smoke sessions prove live tool behavior. Documentation and diagnostics must state this limitation explicitly and must never claim a physical sandbox.

pre_publication.rule: BMAD planning artifacts own scope and pre-publication status; bmad-sprint-planning owns readiness and the sprint-status projection writes. The Linear issue, if it exists yet, is not authoritative.

artifacts: Linear issue carrying the story-key-anchored spec
post_publication.rule: Linear owns implementation context and execution state from In Progress to Done. Local authoring files are evidence/history, not competing authority.

sprint_planning.rule: These are internal intents of bmad-sprint-planning, not separate active Storm workflows. Upstream's deterministic script parses and writes the projection; inference is fallback-only and must warn.

authorities.phase_decides_rule: Pre-publication, sprint-status.yaml wins; post-publication, Linear wins; on disagreement the phase decides. If the phase cannot be determined, stop and ask rather than overwrite.

artifact_lifecycle.before_publication: epics.md, sprint-status.yaml, and the BMAD story file own scope/context.
artifact_lifecycle.at_publication: storm-linear publish writes the story-key-anchored spec to the Linear issue at Todo + ready-for-agent and returns to storm-build. storm-build performs exactly one adaptive planner call afterward; the Linear write and planner projection are separate operations.
artifact_lifecycle.after_publication: Linear owns implementation context/state; local authoring files are evidence/history, not competing authority.

route_selection.retention: The selected route is captured once before any Storm side effect and retained through completion; completion never rereads mutable sprint state to choose behavior.
route_selection.ambiguous_or_generic: Fail closed for Storm publish/open/close and sprint projection side effects.
route_selection.planner_call_procedure: Inspect the installed bmad-sprint-planning usage/help; pass --autonomous only if advertised, otherwise invoke its advertised native headless intent or JSON script subcommand. Inspect the result and do not retry guessed forms.

linear_done_planning_failure.result: Linear Done with sprint reconciliation repair required

review_loop_max_rounds.rule: The only source for the review round cap. Directives and templates must reference this setting, never a hard-coded number. Fixes require a complete fresh review pass; non-convergence at the cap leaves the issue In Progress and is reported.

storm-build.unknown_or_missing_mode: hard stop with zero Storm tracker or sprint side effects

bmad-build.side_effect_rule: Direct callers receive no Storm tracker lifecycle hooks; use storm-build for an explicit Storm-managed lifecycle.

bmad-sprint-planning.headless_capability: use only the installed skill's advertised flag, native intent, or script subcommand

bmad-quick-dev.ambiguous_rule: No Storm side effect; direct upstream forwarding remains unwrapped.

storm-grilling.handoff: return the agreed Seams & test points as an explicit payload to the calling wrapper; do not write a story/spec artifact

storm-linear.publish.caller_responsibility: return to storm-build for exactly one adaptive planner call

effects: Linear issue mirror of BMAD scope

storm-linear.close.caller_responsibility: storm-build decides whether to perform exactly one planner reconciliation call

/create-story.rule: Delegates to storm-build author with an explicit story key; it never delegates to direct bmad-build and never creates a second lifecycle.

/to-spec.rule: Retired because it could bypass storm-build author's seam verification and one planner readiness call. Use storm-build author with an explicit story key.

/to-tickets.rule: Thin post-publication adapter to storm-linear slice; operator-invoked only, never a workflow step.

/implement.rule: Delegates to storm-build implement with an explicit target. It never delegates to direct bmad-build, opens, commits, or closes independently, and does not bypass the Polytoken gates.

/quick-dev.rule: Warns as a historical alias, then forwards the original input directly to upstream bmad-build. It is intentionally unwrapped by Storm and has no Storm lifecycle side effects.

/tdd.rule: Delegates to storm-tdd at the story's pre-agreed seams.

/code-review.rule: Delegates to bmad-code-review whose on_complete runs storm-cross-review; one merged triage and one loop.

/wayfinder.rule: No storm equivalent; must not be advertised as active.

story-execute.rule: Retired independent tracker/commit/close ownership; any retained worker is bounded and parent-controlled. Must not be advertised as active.

story-plan.rule: Retired; replaced by storm-build with explicit route selection. Must not be advertised as active.

definitions.scoped: Story exists in epics.md and sprint-status.yaml backlog; BMAD authority.
definitions.authoring: storm-build author route active; story resolution and context loading done before invoking upstream bmad-build.
definitions.authored: Grilling confirmed shared understanding; story file drafted; optional spec review done or declined.
definitions.published: storm-linear publish succeeded; issue carries the story-key-anchored spec at Todo + ready-for-agent.
definitions.ready_for_dev: bmad-sprint-planning projection moved the entry to ready-for-dev after successful publication.
definitions.planning: Polytoken plan facet; implementation plan recorded with write_plan. Issue remains Todo.
definitions.plan_reviewed: Plan review discipline complete; ready for handoff_plan.
definitions.goal_activated: handoff_plan approved; saved-session goal active; execute facet entered.
definitions.executing: Execute facet active; goal not yet re-verified in this session.
definitions.goal_verified: read_goal confirms the implementation goal is active.
definitions.open: storm-linear open moved the issue (or child ticket) to In Progress.
definitions.implementing: Open verified; implementation mutation, TDD seams, and red/green evidence permitted.
definitions.close_ready: Completion record commented on the issue before any state change.
definitions.reconciled: sprint-status.yaml reconciled to done under the story key (story close only).
definitions.child_done: Child ticket moved to Done; nothing reconciled; last child reports the story ready to close.
definitions.halted_pre_open: Handoff rejected/cancelled or no active goal; issue remains Todo; mutation forbidden.
definitions.halted_in_progress: Non-clean exit (review non-converged, tests failing, or completion commit failed); issue remains In Progress.

transitions.note: Publication failure leaves the local projection untouched; report the failure with exactly what should have been written.
Linear publication succeeded but the one storm-build planner call failed; the issue is published but blocked before implementation and requires sprint-planning repair.

Operator-invoked only. Self-transition: slicing never advances state and never substitutes for sprint_ready_updated — slicing from published still requires sprint_ready_updated before planning may begin.
read_goal confirms the saved implementation goal is active. If no active goal exists, halt before opening the issue.
The session re-reads the issue and confirms In Progress before any implementation mutation.

Every fix invalidates prior shutdown-clean, commit-authorization, and completed-commit evidence. A complete fresh review pass, clean Godot shutdown, and newly authorized completed task commit must all recur before close.
Emit before every completion-relevant Godot process. Only one run may be outstanding; each start invalidates earlier shutdown-clean evidence until its matching clean exit.

Consumes exactly one preceding unmatched godot_run_started after shutdown output is inspected. Any crash, hang, RID allocation leak, Canvas/CanvasItem RID leak, ObjectDB leaked instance, orphan/stray node, or resource still in use is a completion blocker and must be fixed.
The explicit storm-build implement invocation grants bounded authority for exactly one task-scoped completion commit after clean verification; push remains separately authorized.

Fresh clean-shutdown evidence and a successfully completed authorized commit for the current code snapshot are mandatory. The completion record (what shipped, verification actually run, declined findings with reasons, deferred follow-ups) is commented BEFORE any state change.
Linear remains Done; the one storm-build planner reconciliation call failed and repair is required.
Story close only. Unreachable from child_done: a child-ticket close reconciles nothing.
The last child's session reports the story as ready to close rather than closing the parent.

guards.review_round_cap: fix_applied is allowed only while the fresh pass it triggers stays within review_loop_max_rounds: fix_count + 2 <= max_rounds. Past the cap the only valid review exit is review_halted_non_converged, which leaves the issue In Progress.
guards.godot_shutdown_clean_seen: commit_authorized requires fresh godot_shutdown_clean evidence from exactly one matched godot_run_started/godot_shutdown_clean pair, with no run outstanding. Godot verification pairs are valid during implementing, native_reviewed, and review_clean. Any later fix or Godot run invalidates earlier evidence until that run exits clean. A crash, hang, RID allocation leak, Canvas/CanvasItem RID leak, ObjectDB leaked instance, orphan/stray node, or resources still in use diagnostic is a blocker that must be fixed; the target remains In Progress.
guards.commit_authorized_seen: commit_completed consumes one prior unconsumed commit_authorized event. A second commit requires fresh authority only after fix_applied invalidates the prior snapshot; no reusable or duplicate completion authority.
guards.completion_evidence_current: completion_commented requires both fresh godot_shutdown_clean evidence and a successfully completed commit for the current code snapshot. godot_run_started invalidates only shutdown evidence; fix_applied invalidates shutdown, commit_authorized, and commit_completed evidence. Every later fix therefore requires fresh review, clean shutdown, and a newly authorized completed task commit. Missing or stale evidence leaves the target In Progress.
guards.story_target: issue_closed requires the opened target to be a story issue.
guards.child_target: child_closed requires the opened target to be a child ticket. Child sessions never mutate, close, or reconcile the parent story.

review_policy.non_convergence: leave the issue In Progress and report outstanding items
review_policy.godot_shutdown_leaks: Any RID allocation, Canvas/CanvasItem, ObjectDB, orphan/stray-node, or resource-still-in-use diagnostic blocks completion even when tests exit zero; fix and rerun before godot_shutdown_clean.
review_policy.single_triage: The generic three-lens reviewer is only an implementation detail feeding the single native-plus-cross-review triage and loop.

child_story_rules.open_ownership: The execute session that opens an issue owns closing it out.
child_story_rules.child_close: A child-ticket close reconciles nothing and never closes, mutates, or reconciles the parent story.
child_story_rules.roll_up: The last open child's session reports the story as ready to close; the parent story is closed only by its own session.

halt_conditions: unknown or missing storm-build mode stops with zero Storm tracker or sprint side effects
Linear publication success followed by planner_readiness_failed leaves the work published but blocked before implementation
a child-ticket close never invokes planner reconciliation or changes the parent
Linear Done followed by planner_reconciliation_failed remains Linear Done and requires bmad-sprint-planning repair
rejected or cancelled handoff_plan leaves the issue Todo with no implementation mutation
absent active saved goal after handoff blocks storm-linear open
failed or unverified open blocks implementation mutation
review non-convergence at review_loop_max_rounds leaves the issue In Progress
any Godot RID/Canvas/ObjectDB/orphan/resource leak leaves the issue In Progress even when tests exit zero
a failed or unverified completion commit leaves the issue In Progress
non-clean exit of any kind leaves the issue In Progress and is reported explicitly
